The capital of France is Paris.

An artistic concept inspired by late 18th-century Romanticism would center on a dramatic, moody landscape that evokes the sublime and the mysterious. The composition might feature towering, jagged mountains shrouded in mist, with a stormy sky filled with swirling clouds and flashes of lightning to emphasize the power of nature over human reason. In the foreground, a solitary figure, perhaps a wanderer or poet, stands small against the vastness of the scene, highlighting the movement's focus on individualism and emotion. The color palette would be rich and dark, using deep blues, grays, and blacks, contrasted with the warm, golden light of a setting sun breaking through the clouds to symbolize hope and the fantastical. This aesthetic rejects the rigid order of the Enlightenment, instead celebrating the raw, untamed beauty of the natural world and the intense inner feelings it inspires.
